name: Gorod
source: The protagonist receives an unexpected call about an inheritance and travels to a distant, isolated town. Instead of a peaceful transition of ownership, he encounters a place inhabited by strange people with frightening customs. Will you make it out the same, or will this town consume you entirely?
translation: 主角意外接到一通关于遗产继承的电话，只身前往一座偏远闭塞的孤立小镇。然而等待着他的并非平静顺畅的产权交接，而是一群举止诡异、奉行骇人风俗的镇民。你究竟能否毫发无损地全身而退，还是会被这座小镇彻底吞噬？
